requirement.description: {reliability_ruth} proposed that the hand-over from ingestion to validation should start as soon as the data arrives. Waiting for a manual request is the main reason the validation step gets skipped when the data is late.
requirement.fact: {reliability_ruth} proposed that the hand-over from ingestion to validation should start as soon as the data arrives.
requirement.reading: Waiting for a manual request is the main reason the validation step gets skipped when the data is late.

speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I did not propose a full automated pipeline, only that the trigger should fire on arrival rather than waiting for a human to click a button. You are missing the point that I am asking for a specific fix to the skip rate, not a redesign of the entire ingestion layer.
output.correction: I am talking about the timing of the validation step, not the scope of the data quality rules themselves. I want the system to check the data as soon as it lands, not to add new checks or change what is being validated.
